title: ee.mesh.lane_grant_preview.v2
description: Canonical read-only approval snapshot emitted by `ee mesh preview-grant <peer-id> --lane <lane>`. Human and JSON renderers consume this same snapshot. It binds copy/schema version, workspace, the opaque enrolled-peer target adapter and grant generation, current/proposed policy generations, the complete generic revision-pinned memory and mesh-ledger candidate set, sample strategy/limit, exact ordered redacted samples, redaction rules and scanner generation, and caution codes. Ordinary output is deterministic and token-free. Only explicit robot issuance adds the optional sensitive approvalToken object.

copyVersion.description: Operator-copy and renderer contract version. A copy change requires a new value and invalidates outstanding approvals.

workspaceId.description: Exact workspace context against which the preview was computed and to which approval verification is bound.

grantGeneration.description: Exact target generation observed by this preview. Grant applies by compare-and-swap and advances it; revoke also advances it, making this preview stale.

candidateSet.description: Complete canonical candidate set considered by the preview, not only sampled rows. Memory pins bind the workspace mutation generation. Mesh-ledger pins bind every immutable event or retained body reference authorized by the proposed lane. Ordering is deterministic and approval-bound; no event JSON, content/event digest, body-cache key, URI, or policy JSON is exposed.

affectedMemoryCount.description: Total memories that would become visible under the proposed effective policy, computed across the complete candidate set.

affectedLedgerEventCount.description: Exact number of immutable mesh-ledger events whose lane material, or whose retained body reference for a body grant, is authorized by the proposed lane through the production outbound policy engine.

redactedFromExposureCount.description: Candidate memories that remain hidden by redaction-class policy even if the proposed lane decision is allow.

previewSampleLimit.description: Effective bounded sample limit after applying the default and the 500-row hard ceiling.

previewSample.description: Exact ordered, already-redacted sample rendered to humans and JSON consumers. No unkeyed sample or content hash is emitted.

redactionScannerGeneration.description: Opaque source-derived generation of the ee-controlled redaction scanner implementation. It changes across scanner-logic upgrades without exposing any memory-content hash.

cautionCodes.description: Canonical ordered caution vocabulary bound into approval verification. It matches the kinds represented by cautions.

approvalToken.description: Present only when a robot explicitly requests --issue-approval-token. Ordinary human and JSON previews omit this field and remain deterministic.

adapterVersion.description: Versioned M0 adapter boundary consumed by later exact-node identity migrations.

peerId.description: Opaque enrolled-peer lookup handle. It is not a cryptographic identity and does not expose the adapter's internal origin-node binding.

policyGeneration.description: Deterministic generation derived from the exact policy inputs that affect this decision. Approval goes stale when it changes.

revisionId.description: Opaque, kind-domain-separated exposure-revision pin. Memory revisions include the workspace's monotonic source-mutation generation. Immutable mesh-ledger revisions use only event identity, never event JSON, content/event digests, body-cache keys, URIs, or policy JSON.

sampleStrategy.description: The random strategy is deterministic for the snapshot's fixed sampling input; issuance randomness affects only the optional bearer, never sample selection.

trustClass.description: Canonical six-class vocabulary from src/models/trust.rs. `peer_human_attested` records a signed active-member origin that declared `human_explicit`; it does not prove a human typed the row.

contentPreview.description: At most 100 Unicode scalar values from the already-redacted memory body.
